I loved pursuing multiple options.

sentences.en: Out with M and her friends at an “Asian Fusion” restaurant1, I got a text from A.
sentences.zh: 我和 M 和她的朋友在一家“亚洲融合”餐厅 1 外出，我收到了 A 发来的短信。

sentences.en: She’d reconsidered and wanted to see me again.
sentences.zh: 她重新考虑了并想再次见到我。

sentences.en: I thought about the alternative timeline here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里考虑了替代时间线。

sentences.en: A choice between someone who’s quiet and slow-burning versus seeing through an unfinished story with someone I was infatuated with.
sentences.zh: 是选择一个安静、缓慢燃烧的人，还是和一个我迷恋的人一起看完一个未完成的故事。

sentences.en: Maybe it wasn’t even a trade-off at all.
sentences.zh: 也许这根本不是一种权衡。

sentences.en: M and I weren’t exclusive.
sentences.zh: M 和我并不排斥。

sentences.en: I loved pursuing multiple options.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢追求多种选择。

blocks.html_en: I didn’t text back.

sentences.en: I didn’t text back.
sentences.zh: 我没有回短信。

blocks.html_en: Felix and I were submitting our generated sites to online directories. Adding features to the platform so they’d rank higher in Google. We implemented a custom analytics system (we wouldn’t use Google Analytics – can’t let the Big Bear know these sites are all related). The money was trickling in – 73 cents commission paid by hobbypartz.com,  $4.95 from fabric.com, $2.2 from undergroundhiphop.com.

sentences.en: Felix and I were submitting our generated sites to online directories.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯和我正在将我们生成的网站提交到在线目录。

sentences.en: Adding features to the platform so they’d rank higher in Google.
sentences.zh: 向平台添加功能，以便它们在 Google 中排名更高。

sentences.en: We implemented a custom analytics system (we wouldn’t use Google Analytics – can’t let the Big Bear know these sites are all related).
sentences.zh: 我们实施了一个自定义分析系统（我们不会使用谷歌分析——不能让大熊知道这些网站都是相关的）。

sentences.en: The money was trickling in – 73 cents commission paid by hobbypartz.com, $4.95 from fabric.com, $2.2 from undergroundhiphop.com.
sentences.zh: 资金源源不断地流入——hobbypartz.com 支付了 73 美分的佣金，fabric.com 支付了 4.95 美元，undergroundhiphop.com 支付了 2.2 美元。

blocks.html_en: In December, we hit the 100 website milestone. Sixteen years later, I don’t remember how we celebrated but we must’ve done so. That year we made $1,300 on expenses of $1,800.

sentences.en: In December, we hit the 100 website milestone.
sentences.zh: 12 月，我们达到了 100 个网站的里程碑。

sentences.en: Sixteen years later, I don’t remember how we celebrated but we must’ve done so.
sentences.zh: 十六年后，我不记得我们是如何庆祝的，但我们一定是这样做的。

sentences.en: That year we made $1,300 on expenses of $1,800.
sentences.zh: 那一年，我们的支出为 1,800 美元，收入为 1,300 美元。

blocks.html_en: The consolation was that it was money we made out of nothing. And we were building an asset. And it was going to be a future passive income stream.

sentences.en: The consolation was that it was money we made out of nothing.
sentences.zh: 令人欣慰的是，我们是白手起家的。

sentences.en: And we were building an asset.
sentences.zh: 我们正在建设一项资产。

sentences.en: And it was going to be a future passive income stream.
sentences.zh: 这将成为未来的被动收入来源。

blocks.html_en: In 2011, Felix and I stayed “in business” but did not grow our network of sites. I remember tweaking things and experimenting with variations of the designs. All to try and encourage more clicks on the “buy now” button. I could see that we had several new competitors running the same play. Their techniques for ranking were more risky and more effective than ours: creating vast numbers of sites by using “temporary domain” services instead of paying for each domain name.

sentences.en: In 2011, Felix and I stayed “in business” but did not grow our network of sites.
sentences.zh: 2011 年，菲利克斯和我继续“营业”，但没有发展我们的网站网络。

sentences.en: I remember tweaking things and experimenting with variations of the designs.
sentences.zh: 我记得调整过一些东西并尝试过不同的设计。

sentences.en: All to try and encourage more clicks on the “buy now” button.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是为了尝试鼓励更多人点击“立即购买”按钮。

sentences.en: I could see that we had several new competitors running the same play.
sentences.zh: 我可以看到我们有几个新的竞争对手在玩同样的游戏。

sentences.en: Their techniques for ranking were more risky and more effective than ours: creating vast numbers of sites by using “temporary domain” services instead of paying for each domain name.
sentences.zh: 他们的排名技术比我们的风险更大，也更有效：通过使用“临时域名”服务创建大量网站，而不是为每个域名付费。

blocks.html_en: I was conservative and insisted that we don’t stoop to this level. I also insisted that we avoid putting paid ads on our sites, thinking that we should keep our visitors 100% focused on clicking the “buy” button. I took on Freelance work for extra cash. This side income allowed me to stretch my savings for much longer than I expected.

sentences.en: I was conservative and insisted that we don’t stoop to this level.
sentences.zh: 我很保守，坚持认为我们不要堕落到这个水平。

sentences.en: I also insisted that we avoid putting paid ads on our sites, thinking that we should keep our visitors 100% focused on clicking the “buy” button.
sentences.zh: 我还坚持避免在我们的网站上投放付费广告，认为我们应该让访问者 100% 专注于点击“购买”按钮。

sentences.en: I took on Freelance work for extra cash.
sentences.zh: 我为了额外的现金而从事自由职业。

sentences.en: This side income allowed me to stretch my savings for much longer than I expected.
sentences.zh: 这笔额外收入使我能够将储蓄的使用时间远远超出我的预期。

blocks.html_en: I had a lot of extra time on my hands and decided to get into coffee as just something to do. I’d frequently go to the hip 3rd-wave cafes that were opening up in Felix’s neighbourhood. Taking a book to read, I’d insist on always ordering an Americano. My logic being that it’s such a simple drink that there was “nowhere to hide” if a barista wasn’t hitting the high notes.

sentences.en: I had a lot of extra time on my hands and decided to get into coffee as just something to do.
sentences.zh: 我有很多多余的时间，所以决定把咖啡当作一件事情来做。

sentences.en: I’d frequently go to the hip 3rd-wave cafes that were opening up in Felix’s neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 我经常去菲利克斯附近新开的时尚第三波咖啡馆。

sentences.en: Taking a book to read, I’d insist on always ordering an Americano.
sentences.zh: 带书去读时，我会坚持总是点一杯美式咖啡。

sentences.en: My logic being that it’s such a simple drink that there was “nowhere to hide” if a barista wasn’t hitting the high notes.
sentences.zh: 我的逻辑是，这是一种如此简单的饮料，如果咖啡师没有达到高调，那么“无处可藏”。

blocks.html_en: One favourite was a combination menswear and cafe run by 3 friends, each working there part-time. It had kickass Americanos for $2. I called it “Coffee / Clothes”, but M would point out that this wasn’t its actual name. It was just one of the phrases stuck on their window and more catchy than the cafe’s true name: Lost & Found.

sentences.en: One favourite was a combination menswear and cafe run by 3 friends, each working there part-time.
sentences.zh: 最喜欢的是由 3 个朋友经营的男装和咖啡馆组合，每个人都在那里兼职。

sentences.en: It had kickass Americanos for $2.
sentences.zh: 它有很棒的美式咖啡，售价 2 美元。

sentences.en: I called it “Coffee / Clothes”, but M would point out that this wasn’t its actual name.
sentences.zh: 我称之为“咖啡/衣服”，但 M 会指出这不是它的真实名称。

sentences.en: It was just one of the phrases stuck on their window and more catchy than the cafe’s true name: Lost & Found.
sentences.zh: 这只是贴在他们窗户上的短语之一，比咖啡馆的真实名称更吸引人：失物招领。

blocks.html_en: My relationship with M was developing slowly. We listened to Miniature Tigers and Com Truise. She introduced me to GRUM. We were seeing each other once a week despite being always free on an entrepreneur’s and student’s schedule. I needed a lot of space away from people.

sentences.en: My relationship with M was developing slowly.
sentences.zh: 我和M的关系发展得很慢。

sentences.en: We listened to Miniature Tigers and Com Truise.
sentences.zh: 我们听了 Miniature Tigers 和 Com Truise。

sentences.en: She introduced me to GRUM.
sentences.zh: 她把我介绍给了格鲁姆。

sentences.en: We were seeing each other once a week despite being always free on an entrepreneur’s and student’s schedule.
sentences.zh: 尽管企业家和学生的日程安排总是空闲的，但我们还是每周见一次面。

sentences.en: I needed a lot of space away from people.
sentences.zh: 我需要远离人群的大量空间。

blocks.html_en: In April, M invited me to watch the fashion show that served as her program’s graduation. That was the first time I’ve seen any of her designs. The models with her collection were last to go down the runway – a place of honour closing out the show. Her clothes were geometrical, futuristic but flattering. I really liked them!2

sentences.en: In April, M invited me to watch the fashion show that served as her program’s graduation.
sentences.zh: 四月份，M邀请我观看作为她项目毕业典礼的时装秀。

sentences.en: That was the first time I’ve seen any of her designs.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次看到她的设计。

sentences.en: The models with her collection were last to go down the runway – a place of honour closing out the show.
sentences.zh: 带着她的系列的模特最后走上T台——这是一场结束时装秀的荣耀之地。

sentences.en: Her clothes were geometrical, futuristic but flattering.
sentences.zh: 她的衣服充满几何感，充满未来感，但又很讨人喜欢。

sentences.en: I really liked them!2
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢他们！2

blocks.html_en: That year, I made $5,300 from the websites and freelancing.

sentences.en: That year, I made $5,300 from the websites and freelancing.
sentences.zh: 那一年，我通过网站和自由职业赚了 5,300 美元。

blocks.html_en: Felix and I were restless to make more money. And that meant adding more websites. So early in 2012 I set out to recruit an intern to increase our capacity. I ended up at a “Students For Startups” event hosted by a nearby university. This was a kind of speed-dating event where students in the Entrepreneurship program would talk with founders, and both parties could choose each other for an internship.

sentences.en: Felix and I were restless to make more money.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯和我焦躁不安地想要赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: And that meant adding more websites.
sentences.zh: 这意味着添加更多网站。

sentences.en: So early in 2012 I set out to recruit an intern to increase our capacity.
sentences.zh: 因此，2012 年初，我开始招募一名实习生来增加我们的产能。

sentences.en: I ended up at a “Students For Startups” event hosted by a nearby university.
sentences.zh: 我最终参加了附近一所大学主办的“学生创业”活动。

sentences.en: This was a kind of speed-dating event where students in the Entrepreneurship program would talk with founders, and both parties could choose each other for an internship.
sentences.zh: 这是一种快速约会活动，创业项目的学生与创始人交谈，双方可以互相选择实习机会。

blocks.html_en: There were 8 entrepreneurs and 16 students at the event. And a twist:

sentences.en: There were 8 entrepreneurs and 16 students at the event.
sentences.zh: 此次活动共有8名企业家和16名学生参加。

sentences.en: And a twist:
sentences.zh: 还有一个转折：

blocks.html_en: Each entrepreneur could only choose one student. Each student could only select one entrepreneur. If you didn’t match then there was no internship.

sentences.en: Each entrepreneur could only choose one student.
sentences.zh: 每个创业者只能选择一名学生。

sentences.en: Each student could only select one entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 每个学生只能选择一名企业家。

sentences.en: If you didn’t match then there was no internship.
sentences.zh: 如果不匹配就没有实习机会。

blocks.html_en: It was high-stakes, and I had to spot talented students while schmoozing them with a story of why they should do repetitive labour for us on websites that hardly brought in any cash.

sentences.en: It was high-stakes, and I had to spot talented students while schmoozing them with a story of why they should do repetitive labour for us on websites that hardly brought in any cash.
sentences.zh: 这是高风险的，我必须发现有才华的学生，同时用一个故事与他们闲聊，告诉他们为什么他们应该在几乎不带来任何现金的网站上为我们做重复的劳动。

blocks.html_en: There was one student who stood head and shoulders above all the rest. She was clearly ambitious and capable. She already had her own business, making jewellery and selling it online. With her understanding of e-business and my ability to teach her all the digital marketing and tech tricks, the benefits of working together were undeniable.

sentences.en: There was one student who stood head and shoulders above all the rest.
sentences.zh: 有一个学生，比其他人都遥遥领先。

sentences.en: She was clearly ambitious and capable.
sentences.zh: 她显然雄心勃勃，能力出众。

sentences.en: She already had her own business, making jewellery and selling it online.
sentences.zh: 她已经有了自己的生意，制作珠宝并在网上销售。

sentences.en: With her understanding of e-business and my ability to teach her all the digital marketing and tech tricks, the benefits of working together were undeniable.
sentences.zh: 凭借她对电子商务的理解以及我教她所有数字营销和技术技巧的能力，合作的好处是不可否认的。

blocks.html_en: There was just one complication: I found her very attractive. Both physically and her entrepreneurial streak. Remember, I was going to be a millionaire by 30. We were on the same wavelength. It was going to be the Dream Team. I just knew it in my weaselly little bones.

sentences.en: There was just one complication: I found her very attractive.
sentences.zh: 只有一个复杂之处：我发现她非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: Both physically and her entrepreneurial streak.
sentences.zh: 无论是身体上还是她的创业精神。

sentences.en: Remember, I was going to be a millionaire by 30.
sentences.zh: 请记住，我将在 30 岁时成为百万富翁。

sentences.en: We were on the same wavelength.
sentences.zh: 我们的波长相同。

sentences.en: It was going to be the Dream Team.
sentences.zh: 这将是梦之队。

sentences.en: I just knew it in my weaselly little bones.
sentences.zh: 我只是在我狡猾的小骨头里知道这一点。

blocks.html_en: Dear reader, today I may be wise and a paragon of good behaviour, but at 25 I knew that I couldn’t just keep it professional. So I had to think about the slow-burning relationship I was in, and the exciting possibilities of an alternative path – listen, I wasn’t even doing anything, it was pure optionality, you heard of optionality yeah?

sentences.en: Dear reader, today I may be wise and a paragon of good behaviour, but at 25 I knew that I couldn’t just keep it professional.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的读者，今天的我可能很聪明，是良好行为的典范，但在 25 岁时，我知道我不能只保持专业。

sentences.en: So I had to think about the slow-burning relationship I was in, and the exciting possibilities of an alternative path – listen, I wasn’t even doing anything, it was pure optionality, you heard of optionality yeah?
sentences.zh: 所以我必须考虑我所处的缓慢燃烧的关系，以及替代道路的令人兴奋的可能性——听着，我什至没有做任何事情，这纯粹是可选性，你听说过可选性吗？

blocks.html_en: I decided to keep out of trouble.

sentences.en: I decided to keep out of trouble.
sentences.zh: 我决定远离麻烦。

blocks.html_en: My choice was the second-strongest student in the room, D. He was a brash guy who talked the talk and had a focus on entrepreneurship that very few in business school have.3 And D chose me as well!

sentences.en: My choice was the second-strongest student in the room, D.
sentences.zh: 我的选择是房间里第二强的学生，D。

sentences.en: He was a brash guy who talked the talk and had a focus on entrepreneurship that very few in business school have.3 And D chose me as well!
sentences.zh: 他是一个傲慢的人，说话很健谈，并且专注于创业精神，这是商学院很少有的人。3 D 也选择了我！

blocks.html_en: Afterwards, the administration sent me an email: D wasn’t supposed to be in that room. He wasn’t enrolled in the co-op entrepreneurship course at all. They didn’t even know if he even wanted to enter the course. Wow – D had moxie.

sentences.en: Afterwards, the administration sent me an email: D wasn’t supposed to be in that room.
sentences.zh: 之后，政府给我发了一封电子邮件：D 不应该在那个房间里。

sentences.en: He wasn’t enrolled in the co-op entrepreneurship course at all.
sentences.zh: 他根本没有参加合作创业课程。

sentences.en: They didn’t even know if he even wanted to enter the course.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不知道他是否想参加课程。

sentences.en: Wow – D had moxie.
sentences.zh: 哇——D 很有勇气。

blocks.html_en: D ended up interning for us. I showed him how to organize the datafeeds of thousands of products into categories. And then he went to work. I would send him new work assignments by email. We would meet every two weeks to review his progress.

sentences.en: D ended up interning for us.
sentences.zh: D 最终为我们实习。

sentences.en: I showed him how to organize the datafeeds of thousands of products into categories.
sentences.zh: 我向他展示了如何将数千种产品的数据源组织成类别。

sentences.en: And then he went to work.
sentences.zh: 然后他就去上班了。

sentences.en: I would send him new work assignments by email.
sentences.zh: 我会通过电子邮件向他发送新的工作任务。

sentences.en: We would meet every two weeks to review his progress.
sentences.zh: 我们每两周会面一次，回顾他的进展。

blocks.html_en: Surprisingly, D was terrible at his job.

sentences.en: Surprisingly, D was terrible at his job.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，D 的工作表现很糟糕。

blocks.html_en: He was slow to populate the sites with products. What’s more, during our meetings he’d constantly pester me with probing questions about my business decisions. Why did I build things this particular way? Why not put advertisements on the websites? How come it takes so long to create each site? Are you reselling these domains as a supplemental income stream?

sentences.en: He was slow to populate the sites with products.
sentences.zh: 他在网站上填充产品的速度很慢。

sentences.en: What’s more, during our meetings he’d constantly pester me with probing questions about my business decisions.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，在我们的会议期间，他不断地向我提出有关我的商业决策的探究性问题。

sentences.en: Why did I build things this particular way?
sentences.zh: 为什么我要以这种特殊的方式构建东西？

sentences.en: Why not put advertisements on the websites?
sentences.zh: 为什么不在网站上投放广告？

sentences.en: How come it takes so long to create each site?
sentences.zh: 为什么创建每个网站都需要这么长时间？

sentences.en: Are you reselling these domains as a supplemental income stream?
sentences.zh: 您是否将转售这些域名作为补充收入来源？

blocks.html_en: I had very good reasons for every decision. And here was this student playing Big Business Consultant when he can’t even do his assigned work on time. Sheesh.

sentences.en: I had very good reasons for every decision.
sentences.zh: 我的每一个决定都有充分的理由。

sentences.en: And here was this student playing Big Business Consultant when he can’t even do his assigned work on time.
sentences.zh: 这位学生甚至无法按时完成分配的工作，却扮演着大企业顾问的角色。

sentences.en: Sheesh.
sentences.zh: 谢什。

blocks.html_en: D was my first encounter with a rare type of person. I’ve only met two others like him in my life. These people are:

sentences.en: D was my first encounter with a rare type of person.
sentences.zh: D是我第一次遇到一种罕见的人。

sentences.en: I’ve only met two others like him in my life.
sentences.zh: 我一生中只遇到过两个像他一样的人。

sentences.en: These people are:
sentences.zh: 这些人是：

blocks.html_en: • Terrible at day-to-day execution and require lots of support from others.

sentences.en: Terrible at day-to-day execution and require lots of support from others.
sentences.zh: 日常执行很糟糕，需要其他人的大量支持。

blocks.html_en: • Big visionaries, they explore cutting-edge ideas that push others out of their comfort zone.

sentences.en: Big visionaries, they explore cutting-edge ideas that push others out of their comfort zone.
sentences.zh: 他们是远见卓识的人，探索推动他人走出舒适区的前沿想法。

blocks.html_en: • Big gossips – constantly informing you of what others in the organization are working on.

sentences.en: Big gossips – constantly informing you of what others in the organization are working on.
sentences.zh: 大八卦——不断地告诉你组织中其他人正在做什么。

blocks.html_en: • Politicians who try to influence things at a level they haven’t reached yet.

sentences.en: Politicians who try to influence things at a level they haven’t reached yet.
sentences.zh: 试图以他们尚未达到的水平影响事物的政治家。

blocks.html_en: These people’s qualities match only one role you’d see in a corporation. People in that role do no hands-on work and have to rely on experts for that. Their job is to over-communicate a certain message. They are paid to think ahead and push others to change in uncomfortable directions. That role: CEO.

sentences.en: These people’s qualities match only one role you’d see in a corporation.
sentences.zh: 这些人的品质只符合您在公司中看到的一种角色。

sentences.en: People in that role do no hands-on work and have to rely on experts for that.
sentences.zh: 担任该角色的人员不需要亲自动手工作，必须依靠专家来完成。

sentences.en: Their job is to over-communicate a certain message.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作是过度传达某种信息。

sentences.en: They are paid to think ahead and push others to change in uncomfortable directions.
sentences.zh: 他们受雇来提前思考并推动其他人朝不舒服的方向做出改变。

sentences.en: That role: CEO.
sentences.zh: 该角色：首席执行官。

blocks.html_en: People like D are born CEOs.

sentences.en: People like D are born CEOs.
sentences.zh: 像D这样的人是天生的CEO。

blocks.html_en: The tragedy is that, despite their innate skills for the top, they still need to climb many rungs of drudgery to earn their place there. Most of them will become casualties of the journey. Unless they are spotted and supported.

sentences.en: The tragedy is that, despite their innate skills for the top, they still need to climb many rungs of drudgery to earn their place there.
sentences.zh: 悲剧在于，尽管他们天生具备登上顶峰的能力，但他们仍然需要爬上许多苦差事才能获得一席之地。

sentences.en: Most of them will become casualties of the journey.
sentences.zh: 他们中的大多数人都会成为旅途中的牺牲品。

sentences.en: Unless they are spotted and supported.
sentences.zh: 除非他们被发现并得到支持。

blocks.html_en: D’s co-op period ended. I was dismissive of his advice but Felix was open to it. Felix already had an inkling that my approach was too conservative. Eventually, I ended up implementing all of D’s recommendations. He lit a fire under me. D taught us that the key to our business was volume – standing up new websites as fast as possible. So why were we focusing so much on quality, which was holding us back?!

sentences.en: D’s co-op period ended.
sentences.zh: D的合作期结束了。

sentences.en: I was dismissive of his advice but Felix was open to it.
sentences.zh: 我对他的建议不屑一顾，但菲利克斯对此持开放态度。

sentences.en: Felix already had an inkling that my approach was too conservative.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯已经感觉到我的做法太保守了。

sentences.en: Eventually, I ended up implementing all of D’s recommendations.
sentences.zh: 最终，我最终实施了 D 的所有建议。

sentences.en: He lit a fire under me.
sentences.zh: 他在我身下点燃了一把火。

sentences.en: D taught us that the key to our business was volume – standing up new websites as fast as possible.
sentences.zh: D 告诉我们，我们业务的关键是数量——尽快建立新网站。

sentences.en: So why were we focusing so much on quality, which was holding us back?!
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么我们如此关注质量，而这却阻碍了我们呢？！

blocks.html_en: I recoded the platform so that it would auto-categorize products into “good enough” buckets, and I stopped spending so much time picking the perfect domain name for each site. We created the next 100 websites in a fraction of the time it took us to create the first hundred. We put ads on the sites. Instead of distracting visitors, they doubled revenue.

sentences.en: I recoded the platform so that it would auto-categorize products into “good enough” buckets, and I stopped spending so much time picking the perfect domain name for each site.
sentences.zh: 我重新编码了该平台，以便它可以自动将产品分类到“足够好”的类别中，并且我不再花费太多时间为每个网站挑选完美的域名。

sentences.en: We created the next 100 websites in a fraction of the time it took us to create the first hundred.
sentences.zh: 我们创建了接下来的 100 个网站，所用时间只是创建前 100 个网站所需时间的一小部分。

sentences.en: We put ads on the sites.
sentences.zh: 我们在网站上投放广告。

sentences.en: Instead of distracting visitors, they doubled revenue.
sentences.zh: 他们不但没有分散游客的注意力，反而使收入翻了一番。

blocks.html_en: The business was succeeding. But I was losing interest. I got a contract job an hour and a half away. I’d invited M to move in with me. We were listening to Twin Shadow and Childish Gambino. We even managed to see the first tour of a mysterious Toronto musician before he got globally famous. I had to move my clothes out of the bedroom and into a hallway closet to make space. I’d change frenetically in that hallway before going to work. It was hard to share my home with M. The truth is, I was jealous of Felix. He still had his freedom and I could see the cage coming down on me.

sentences.en: The business was succeeding.
sentences.zh: 生意很成功。

sentences.en: But I was losing interest.
sentences.zh: 但我正在失去兴趣。

sentences.en: I got a contract job an hour and a half away.
sentences.zh: 我在一个半小时路程外找到了一份合同工作。

sentences.en: I’d invited M to move in with me.
sentences.zh: 我邀请 M 搬来和我一起住。

sentences.en: We were listening to Twin Shadow and Childish Gambino.
sentences.zh: 我们正在听《Twin Shadow》和《Childish Gambino》。

sentences.en: We even managed to see the first tour of a mysterious Toronto musician before he got globally famous.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至还观看了一位神秘的多伦多音乐家在他享誉全球之前的首次巡演。

sentences.en: I had to move my clothes out of the bedroom and into a hallway closet to make space.
sentences.zh: 我不得不把衣服从卧室移到走廊的壁橱里，以腾出空间。

sentences.en: I’d change frenetically in that hallway before going to work.
sentences.zh: 上班前我会在走廊里疯狂地换衣服。

sentences.en: It was hard to share my home with M.
sentences.zh: 与 M 分享我的家很困难。

sentences.en: The truth is, I was jealous of Felix.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我嫉妒菲利克斯。

sentences.en: He still had his freedom and I could see the cage coming down on me.
sentences.zh: 他仍然有他的自由，我可以看到笼子向我袭来。

blocks.html_en:
Was life so difficult because of M or would it be equally challenging to live with any other person?
I did a lot of soul searching. I decided that I’d have the same problems living with anyone after I’d tasted life on my own. After all, we’re talking about the guy who needed so much space he’d only see his new girlfriend one day a week.

sentences.en: Was life so difficult because of M or would it be equally challenging to live with any other person?I did a lot of soul searching.
sentences.zh: 生活是因为M而变得如此困难吗？或者与其他人一起生活也会同样具有挑战性吗？我做了很多自我反省。

sentences.en: I decided that I’d have the same problems living with anyone after I’d tasted life on my own.
sentences.zh: 在我尝到了独自生活的滋味后，我决定与任何人一起生活都会遇到同样的问题。

sentences.en: After all, we’re talking about the guy who needed so much space he’d only see his new girlfriend one day a week.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，我们谈论的是一个需要如此多空间的人，他每周只能见到他的新女友一天。

blocks.html_en: Living with M, I realized that some things will never change. That they are a permanent part of the deal in having M in my life. At the pace of molasses, this attractive, creative, crazy funny woman kept revealing herself to me. I don’t think that I’ll ever fully know her. And I don’t want to: I still don’t know her birth name. Only the one she chose for herself.

sentences.en: Living with M, I realized that some things will never change.
sentences.zh: 和M一起生活，我意识到有些事情永远不会改变。

sentences.en: That they are a permanent part of the deal in having M in my life.
sentences.zh: 他们是我生活中 M 的永久组成部分。

sentences.en: At the pace of molasses, this attractive, creative, crazy funny woman kept revealing herself to me.
sentences.zh: 这位迷人、富有创造力、疯狂有趣的女人以糖蜜般的节奏不断向我展示自己。

sentences.en: I don’t think that I’ll ever fully know her.
sentences.zh: 我认为我永远不会完全了解她。

sentences.en: And I don’t want to: I still don’t know her birth name.
sentences.zh: 我不想：我仍然不知道她的出生名字。

sentences.en: Only the one she chose for herself.
sentences.zh: 只有她自己选的那一个。

blocks.html_en: I got a permanent job. And then another. M and I got married. There was less time to do what I wanted and more time spent coordinating, tiptoeing, compromising. But, even with my day job, I could still squeeze in time in the evenings to learn a new programming language. Two months before M was due with our first child,I decided I’d had enough of my consulting job, and went freelance. I’m sure she loved that.

sentences.en: I got a permanent job.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一份永久工作。

sentences.en: And then another.
sentences.zh: 然后是另一个。

sentences.en: M and I got married.
sentences.zh: 我和M结婚了。

sentences.en: There was less time to do what I wanted and more time spent coordinating, tiptoeing, compromising.
sentences.zh: 做我想做的事情的时间越来越少，而花在协调、小心翼翼、妥协上的时间却越来越多。

sentences.en: But, even with my day job, I could still squeeze in time in the evenings to learn a new programming language.
sentences.zh: 但是，即使白天有工作，我仍然可以在晚上挤出时间来学习新的编程语言。

sentences.en: Two months before M was due with our first child,I decided I’d had enough of my consulting job, and went freelance.
sentences.zh: 在 M 怀上我们第一个孩子的预产期前两个月，我决定我已经受够了咨询工作，并成为了自由职业者。

sentences.en: I’m sure she loved that.
sentences.zh: 我确信她喜欢那个。

blocks.html_en: When our son was born I was hustling for customers, looking for another job, and waking up to feed him at 4:30am every day. I hated the demands of fatherhood. I felt like I’d died and left a ghost to walk the earth. Echoing that Bristol Board with the hundred circles, I’d tell myself: “I am seeing the sunrise with my son. This is good. A good experience together”. I cried on the kitchen floor when no one was around.

sentences.en: When our son was born I was hustling for customers, looking for another job, and waking up to feed him at 4:30am every day.
sentences.zh: 当我们的儿子出生时，我忙着招揽顾客，寻找另一份工作，每天凌晨 4:30 起床给他喂饭。

sentences.en: I hated the demands of fatherhood.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌父亲的要求。

sentences.en: I felt like I’d died and left a ghost to walk the earth.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己已经死了，只剩下一个幽灵在地球上行走。

sentences.en: Echoing that Bristol Board with the hundred circles, I’d tell myself: “I am seeing the sunrise with my son.
sentences.zh: 与布里斯托尔委员会的一百个圆圈相呼应，我告诉自己：“我正在和我的儿子一起看日出。

sentences.en: This is good.
sentences.zh: 这很好。

sentences.en: A good experience together”.
sentences.zh: 一起度过了愉快的经历”。

sentences.en: I cried on the kitchen floor when no one was around.
sentences.zh: 当周围没有人的时候，我在厨房的地板上哭了。

blocks.html_en: Time passed and I landed a good position with managerial responsibilities. There was no more learning of programming languages and no more hobby projects. I felt resentful that my time was being swallowed up by responsibilities to others4. I constantly talked about wishing to write up a specific accomplishment at work, if only I had time. Finally, M told me that I’ve been ruminating about this writeup so much that I need to go get it done. She’ll make uninterrupted time for me to work on it. Because of her, I wrote the damn thing. This was my first long piece of writing. And a first step in a journey I can see only in retrospect.

sentences.en: Time passed and I landed a good position with managerial responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的流逝，我找到了一个担任管理职责的好职位。

sentences.en: There was no more learning of programming languages and no more hobby projects.
sentences.zh: 不再需要学习编程语言，也不再有兴趣项目。

sentences.en: I felt resentful that my time was being swallowed up by responsibilities to others4.
sentences.zh: 我对自己的时间被对他人的责任所吞噬而感到不满4。

sentences.en: I constantly talked about wishing to write up a specific accomplishment at work, if only I had time.
sentences.zh: 我经常说如果有时间的话，希望写下工作中的具体成就。

sentences.en: Finally, M told me that I’ve been ruminating about this writeup so much that I need to go get it done.
sentences.zh: 最后，M 告诉我，我对这篇文章思考了很多，所以我需要去完成它。

sentences.en: She’ll make uninterrupted time for me to work on it.
sentences.zh: 她会为我腾出不间断的时间来做这件事。

sentences.en: Because of her, I wrote the damn thing.
sentences.zh: 因为她，我写下了这该死的东西。

sentences.en: This was my first long piece of writing.
sentences.zh: 这是我的第一篇长文。

sentences.en: And a first step in a journey I can see only in retrospect.
sentences.zh: 我只有在回顾时才能看到旅程的第一步。

blocks.html_en: We moved 3 times in 3 years.

sentences.en: We moved 3 times in 3 years.
sentences.zh: 3年内我们搬了3次家。

blocks.html_en: When we finally felt like we had a handle on life, we welcomed our daughter into the world. Instead of a hollow ghost I was now an enraged demon.

sentences.en: When we finally felt like we had a handle on life, we welcomed our daughter into the world.
sentences.zh: 当我们终于感觉自己掌控了生活时，我们欢迎女儿来到这个世界。

sentences.en: Instead of a hollow ghost I was now an enraged demon.
sentences.zh: 我现在不再是一个空虚的幽灵，而是一个愤怒的恶魔。

blocks.html_en: Throughout the years I thought frequently about Felix.

sentences.en: Throughout the years I thought frequently about Felix.
sentences.zh: 这些年来我经常想起菲利克斯。

blocks.html_en: I would always remember him in that room. I’m watching him side-on in front of that massive window. The room is filled with furniture his mother bought him when he moved out: the black couch, black computer chair, black TV stand, black TV. “Do this for your own children when they move out”, she said. She taught him how to cook basic meals in that first apartment of his. Loved and uncomplicated.

sentences.en: I would always remember him in that room.
sentences.zh: 我会永远记得他在那个房间里。

sentences.en: I’m watching him side-on in front of that massive window.
sentences.zh: 我在那扇巨大的窗户前侧身看着他。

sentences.en: The room is filled with furniture his mother bought him when he moved out: the black couch, black computer chair, black TV stand, black TV.
sentences.zh: 房间里摆满了他妈妈搬出去时给他买的家具：黑色的沙发、黑色的电脑椅、黑色的电视柜、黑色的电视。

sentences.en: “Do this for your own children when they move out”, she said.
sentences.zh: “当你自己的孩子搬出去时，为他们这样做”，她说。

sentences.en: She taught him how to cook basic meals in that first apartment of his.
sentences.zh: 她教他如何在他的第一间公寓里做饭。

sentences.en: Loved and uncomplicated.
sentences.zh: 喜欢又不复杂。

blocks.html_en: It is now 1am. I passed out while putting our daughter to sleep and woke up again. It’s a daily routine that usually takes an hour. It’s been 7 years now. And 7 years since I slept alone with my wife in our bed. First there was a baby between us. Then a little girl. Then a Big Girl.

sentences.en: It is now 1am.
sentences.zh: 现在是凌晨 1 点。

sentences.en: I passed out while putting our daughter to sleep and woke up again.
sentences.zh: 我在哄女儿入睡时昏倒了，然后又醒了。

sentences.en: It’s a daily routine that usually takes an hour.
sentences.zh: 这是日常工作，通常需要一个小时。

sentences.en: It’s been 7 years now.
sentences.zh: 到现在已经7年了。

sentences.en: And 7 years since I slept alone with my wife in our bed.
sentences.zh: 自从我和妻子单独睡在床上已经七年了。

sentences.en: First there was a baby between us.
sentences.zh: 首先我们之间有一个婴儿。

sentences.en: Then a little girl.
sentences.zh: 然后是一个小女孩。

sentences.en: Then a Big Girl.
sentences.zh: 然后是大姑娘。

blocks.html_en: It’s 1am and I’m shuffling in groggy with my hair sticking out where it flattened against the mattress. At the dining table, M is sitting with her pottery. If anyone has a more regrettable relationship with sleep than I, it is her. She’s holding a little bisque-fired vase and putting down white glaze. Then pink. I tell her that I am struck by inspiration to write. But if I get on the computer now, I’ll be fucked tomorrow.

sentences.en: It’s 1am and I’m shuffling in groggy with my hair sticking out where it flattened against the mattress.
sentences.zh: 现在是凌晨 1 点，我昏昏沉沉地拖着脚步，头发平放在床垫上。

sentences.en: At the dining table, M is sitting with her pottery.
sentences.zh: 餐桌旁，M 正拿着她的陶器。

sentences.en: If anyone has a more regrettable relationship with sleep than I, it is her.
sentences.zh: 如果说有谁与睡眠的关系比我更遗憾的话，那就是她了。

sentences.en: She’s holding a little bisque-fired vase and putting down white glaze.
sentences.zh: 她手里拿着一个素烧小花瓶，上面涂着白釉。

sentences.en: Then pink.
sentences.zh: 然后是粉色。

sentences.en: I tell her that I am struck by inspiration to write.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她我受到了写作的启发。

sentences.en: But if I get on the computer now, I’ll be fucked tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 但如果我现在打开电脑，明天我就完蛋了。

blocks.html_en: “Go for it”, she says. “You don’t have work tomorrow and you can take a midday nap”.

sentences.en: “Go for it”, she says.
sentences.zh: “努力吧”，她说。

sentences.en: “You don’t have work tomorrow and you can take a midday nap”.
sentences.zh: “明天没有工作，可以睡个午觉”。

blocks.html_en: Felix is still twenty four.

sentences.en: Felix is still twenty four.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯还二十四岁。

blocks.html_en: I am almost forty.

sentences.en: I am almost forty.
sentences.zh: 我快四十了。

blocks.html_en: Not a ghost anymore. M has me loving IVE and Cukak’s remixes through sheer force of repetition.

sentences.en: Not a ghost anymore.
sentences.zh: 不再是鬼了。

sentences.en: M has me loving IVE and Cukak’s remixes through sheer force of repetition.
sentences.zh: M 通过纯粹的重复力量让我爱上了 IVE 和 Cukak 的混音。

blocks.html_en: I am not a demon. Recently, I played Altın Gün for M. But I figured she’d hate it because the singing would annoy her. And I was right! Hah!

sentences.en: I am not a demon.
sentences.zh: 我不是恶魔。

sentences.en: Recently, I played Altın Gün for M.
sentences.zh: 最近，我为 M 演奏了 Altın Gün。

sentences.en: But I figured she’d hate it because the singing would annoy her.
sentences.zh: 但我想她会讨厌它，因为唱歌会惹恼她。

sentences.en: And I was right!
sentences.zh: 我是对的！

sentences.en: Hah!
sentences.zh: 哈！

blocks.html_en: I am just an ordinary perpetually irritated man. Going through a mid-life reinvention. With a brain like Swiss Cheese from years of sleep deprivation. My son recently told me his favourite song is The Look.

sentences.en: I am just an ordinary perpetually irritated man.
sentences.zh: 我只是一个经常被激怒的普通人。

sentences.en: Going through a mid-life reinvention.
sentences.zh: 经历中年重塑。

sentences.en: With a brain like Swiss Cheese from years of sleep deprivation.
sentences.zh: 拥有像瑞士奶酪一样的大脑，得益于多年的睡眠不足。

sentences.en: My son recently told me his favourite song is The Look.
sentences.zh: 我儿子最近告诉我他最喜欢的歌曲是 The Look。

blocks.html_en: I sneak time away to write and code in the evening. Parenting is less demanding, but I haven’t grown to like it. It’s like: if you feed me a BIG tablespoon of shit every day and then switch to just a little teaspoon daily, I won’t suddenly start liking the taste of shit.

sentences.en: I sneak time away to write and code in the evening.
sentences.zh: 我晚上会抽出时间来写作和编码。

sentences.en: Parenting is less demanding, but I haven’t grown to like it.
sentences.zh: 养育孩子的要求不那么高，但我还没有变得喜欢它。

sentences.en: It’s like: if you feed me a BIG tablespoon of shit every day and then switch to just a little teaspoon daily, I won’t suddenly start liking the taste of shit.
sentences.zh: 就像：如果你每天给我一大汤匙粪便，然后每天只喂一小茶匙，我不会突然开始喜欢粪便的味道。

blocks.html_en: Felix and I went our separate ways. He’s working on his own projects, never slowed down by responsibility to others. Still listening to hip music. Having coffee in that downtown neighbourhood that’s so different from the sleepy, middle-aged, middle-achieving, mid-town neighbourhood where I live. Nothing ever happens in my neighbourhood. I can’t even get a croissant on a Monday because the local shopkeepers decided it’s now a day of rest.

sentences.en: Felix and I went our separate ways.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯和我分道扬镳。

sentences.en: He’s working on his own projects, never slowed down by responsibility to others.
sentences.zh: 他专注于自己的项目，从未因对他人的责任而放慢脚步。

sentences.en: Still listening to hip music.
sentences.zh: 仍在听流行音乐。

sentences.en: Having coffee in that downtown neighbourhood that’s so different from the sleepy, middle-aged, middle-achieving, mid-town neighbourhood where I live.
sentences.zh: 在市中心的街区喝咖啡，这与我居住的昏昏欲睡、中年、中等成就的市中心街区有很大不同。

sentences.en: Nothing ever happens in my neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 我的邻居从来没有发生过任何事情。

sentences.en: I can’t even get a croissant on a Monday because the local shopkeepers decided it’s now a day of rest.
sentences.zh: 周一我什至买不到羊角面包，因为当地店主决定现在休息一天。

blocks.html_en: Do you have a Felix in your life?

sentences.en: Do you have a Felix in your life?
sentences.zh: 你的生活中有菲利克斯吗？

blocks.html_en: I think we all do. We all have a shadow version of ourselves that, as we got middle-aged and weighed down, that version just stayed young and effervescent and kept living life.

sentences.en: I think we all do.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都这样做。

sentences.en: We all have a shadow version of ourselves that, as we got middle-aged and weighed down, that version just stayed young and effervescent and kept living life.
sentences.zh: 我们都有一个自己的影子版本，当我们人到中年、体重减轻时，那个版本只是保持年轻、充满活力，继续生活。

blocks.html_en: I often think about Felix’s freedom.

sentences.en: I often think about Felix’s freedom.
sentences.zh: 我经常想起菲利克斯的自由。

blocks.html_en: But my memory plays tricks on me. I never told you about it being so lonely in that apartment that I cried5. I never lashed out at anyone, hungry and angry that they broke my concentration. But that was because there was nobody there but me. Never made it as an entrepreneur. When I think of that time, it’s a Forever Summer. I don’t remember the Winters. I bet they sucked, cooped up indoors with the next boring website that needed building. Cufflinks! Horse Bridles! Vibrating Cockrings!

sentences.en: But my memory plays tricks on me.
sentences.zh: 但我的记忆跟我开了个玩笑。

sentences.en: I never told you about it being so lonely in that apartment that I cried5.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有告诉过你在那间公寓里我是如此孤独以至于我哭了5。

sentences.en: I never lashed out at anyone, hungry and angry that they broke my concentration.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有对任何人发脾气，因为他们分散了我的注意力，让我感到饥饿和愤怒。

sentences.en: But that was because there was nobody there but me.
sentences.zh: 但那是因为除了我之外没有人。

sentences.en: Never made it as an entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 从来没有成为一名企业家。

sentences.en: When I think of that time, it’s a Forever Summer.
sentences.zh: 当我想起那个时候，那是一个永远的夏天。

sentences.en: I don’t remember the Winters.
sentences.zh: 我不记得冬天了。

sentences.en: I bet they sucked, cooped up indoors with the next boring website that needed building.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌他们很糟糕，和下一个需要建设的无聊网站一起关在室内。

sentences.en: Cufflinks!
sentences.zh: 袖扣！

sentences.en: Horse Bridles!
sentences.zh: 马缰绳！

sentences.en: Vibrating Cockrings!
sentences.zh: 振动公鸡环！

blocks.html_en: I think the most honest thing we can do for our Felixes is to dive further into the fantasy. To flesh out the details of their life. Make them concrete.

sentences.en: I think the most honest thing we can do for our Felixes is to dive further into the fantasy.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们能为我们的菲利克斯做的最诚实的事情就是进一步深入幻想。

sentences.en: To flesh out the details of their life.
sentences.zh: 充实他们生活的细节。

sentences.en: Make them concrete.
sentences.zh: 让它们具体化。

blocks.html_en: When I think about Felix’s partner or children, I can’t help but picture a life similar to my own. Because he also wanted children. He wanted a partner. He wouldn’t have stayed in that neighbourhood. And anyways, that place is not the same as it was sixteen years ago.

sentences.en: When I think about Felix’s partner or children, I can’t help but picture a life similar to my own.
sentences.zh: 当我想到菲利克斯的伴侣或孩子时，我情不自禁地想象出与我相似的生活。

sentences.en: Because he also wanted children.
sentences.zh: 因为他也想要孩子。

sentences.en: He wanted a partner.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个合作伙伴。

sentences.en: He wouldn’t have stayed in that neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 他不会留在那个街区。

sentences.en: And anyways, that place is not the same as it was sixteen years ago.

content_html_zh:
在我的记忆中，总是同一张照片：

他很年轻，二十四岁，坐在客厅靠墙的黑色电脑桌旁。 我从侧面看着他。 他的轮廓出现在巨大的窗户旁，可以看到附近教堂的美丽景色。 外面绿树成荫。 阳光灿烂。

现在是夏天。 大概是“炎热的夏天”，当时我们的朋友 G 和 C 过来闲逛，看看他在做什么。 这是他第一次独自居住的一居室公寓。 有一个小风扇努力抵御35度的高温。 它的直径是 20 厘米，所以它没有什么作用——天气非常热，但仍然是一个美好的时光。 他正在电脑屏幕上向我们所有人展示一些东西。

当他构建该台式机时，他使用了迷你主板，旨在缩小外形尺寸。 但到了最后一步，当到了购买箱子的时候，只有一个大得可笑的箱子可用。 他接过了。 这种妥协让他很恼火，但这是完成构建并继续实现他真正想要的目标的一种务实方式。

菲利克斯和我真的想在 30 岁时成为百万富翁。

我们要通过建立一个网站帝国来实现这一目标。 当时许多电子商务企业都有“联盟计划”。 这个想法是，你通过欺骗手段加入并吸引访问者访问他们的网站，而这些访问者在商家处花费的任何钱都会为你带来 8% 的佣金。 典型的会员只会选择一些产品在他们的个人博客上进行推广。

我们的业务前提更加利基：作为这些联属计划的一部分，一些商家还以“数据源”的形式分享他们的整个产品选择。 这将允许您提取他们的所有产品并集体推广它们。 早在 2010 年，编程技能还很罕见，您可以成功地使用此数据源来生成您自己的电子商务网站，并使其在 Google 上的排名超过原始商家。 访问者会首先访问您的“克隆”网站，当他们单击“购买”按钮时，他们将被带到原始商家的网站。 他们在那里购买任何东西，你都可以收取 8% 的佣金。

如果你认为这个生意很赚钱那你就错了。

一个成功的克隆网站每年只能赚取 100 美元。 但如果您的网站成本低于这个数字，那么这仍然是有利可图的。 通常只需 10 美元即可完成域名注册。 如果您可以大规模制作 100 个网站、200 个网站、500 个网站，那么我们就赚到了真钱。 这就是我进来的地方。

我已经对这个想法进行了概念验证。 然后建立了一个平台，允许一个人创建必要的庞大网站网络。 唯一的问题是，尽管数据源为我们提供了所有产品标题、照片和描述，但构建每个网站仍然需要手动工作。

我们首先要找到一家拥有数据源的电子商务商家，而且该网站的编码非常糟糕，以至于我们自己的克隆网站在谷歌上的排名可能超过他们。 我们会消除数据源中的所有怪癖（每个数据源都有自己的技术问题。 这就是为什么很少有附属机构使用数据源的原因。） 然后，我们会将此产品列表分类 - 就像您对网站导航栏的期望一样。 我们的日子就花在研究、构建和通过撰写联合文章来争取网站链接的循环中。

我花了一年的时间来追求这个想法。 我靠从学校直接找到的一份工作积蓄过活，一份工作是在数字广告网络工作。 第一个挑战是心理学。 每个站点都需要一天的时间来构建 - 我们如何才能保持构建一百个站点的动力？

答案是一块巨大的布里斯托尔棋盘，上面画着 100 个圆圈。 每个圈子都会成为一个网站。 当我们完成一个时，菲利克斯和我会在中间贴一张有趣的贴纸，并在下面写下该网站的域名。

慢慢地，我们建立了decorcurtains.com、scrapbookstarter.com、beddingforcribs.com 和discountboatshoes.com。

当我们手动对产品进行分类时，菲利克斯成为了市场上不同类型胶带的专家（您知道“灯光师胶带”是终极多用途胶带吗？ 比胶带好得多吗？）。 我发现了女装的世界（如果你是个高个子女孩，试试“太阳裙”。 如果您喜欢分层，请尝试“波莱罗”）。

那是多伦多一个美丽的夏天。 年轻且热爱市中心的活力，我去约会并结识了很多无私的女性。

然后我的爱情生活迎来了幸运的突破。 她的名字叫A。 她聪明又美丽——身材矮小、苍白、黑发。 A 是个很酷的女孩，是 CIUT 的 DJ，我对这所大学广播电台情有独钟。

你看，CIUT为我解开了6年的谜团。 我是一个在中东长大的 10 岁孩子，有一天晚上我在睡前偷偷地听着广播。 令人难忘的曲调响起。 就像来自未来埃及文明的传输。 不幸的是，没有办法找到这种类型音乐的名称。 令人沮丧的是，在接下来的几年里，作为加拿大的移民，我经常在电视广告中听到它。 那么近却又遥不可及。 后来，作为一名高中生，他们在凌晨听 CIUT，他们终于给这种风格起了一个名字：Drum n’ Bass。 这为我喜爱的音乐和寻找真实的自我打开了大门。 但那是另一个故事了。

A 和我继续约会。 我会带她去看德罗宁。 她会请我去听黑天使乐队的音乐会，我们会跳到外面和她的同事一起喝酒。 黑天使乐队演奏了险恶的音乐，我的心跳得很快（“哦，那大麻肯定夹杂着什么东西”，A 说）。

尽管住在时尚的市场区，A 的饭菜都是在外面吃的。 “这样做比自己做饭更实惠！”，这是她的逻辑。 菲利克斯和我为此笑了。 他每周都会去同一个市场区购物一次，并且知道在家做饭要便宜得多。 他会推着他的铁丝车在那里轰隆隆地行驶 20 分钟，在他最喜欢的商店逛一圈，然后推着铁丝车从唐人街巨大的地下超市的楼梯上下来。 他开发了一些简单的炒菜食谱。

晚上，菲利克斯和我会去他所在地区的一家独立酒吧喝酒。 他是西皇后西街区的早期中产阶级之一，所以我们有很多时髦的简陋场所可供选择。 那是一个摇滚乐、电子乐盛行的时代，Cut Copy、Ladyhawke 和 Radio Dept. 是我们这个时代的背景音乐。 在潮湿的夜晚，从酒吧步行回家时，紫丁香的气味在空气中的停留时间比白天要长得多。 当我想起菲利克斯时，我将永远记得那些歌曲。 就像你将出国旅行与当时迷恋的专辑联系起来一样。

我无法停止看着A，我着迷了。 但我们之间并不存在化学反应：当我问我是否可以第一次吻她时，她吃了一惊。 “别问我。 去做就对了。”

亲爱的读者，我坚信要表现出礼貌并给女性空间。 这让我非常不性感。 多年来，我逐渐明白，如果一个女人对此感到满意，那么这是兼容性的有力指标。 我和A不再约会了。 我怀疑她会对在那里找到的其他男人感到失望。

每天创建网站是一件无聊的工作。 我会通过庆祝虚构的里程碑来保持我们的士气。 从“嘿，我们完成了第一个网站！”，到庆祝第五个网站（“我们已经完成了二十分之一！” 到第 30 个网站“几乎完成了三分之一！”。 当然，还有 33 个网站的庆祝活动，该网站标志着实际的三分之一。

随着夏天进入秋天，我在网上约会失败了。 你看，我的问题是我才 24 岁。

年轻的女性正在寻找比她们年长的男性。 有了钱和很酷的生活方式.. 比如说，一个27岁的人。

我这个年纪的女性正在寻找一个年龄适中的男性。 一个27岁的人。

比我年长的女性肯定在寻找与我年龄相仿的人。 27岁。

如果我想找到合作伙伴，我只需要做一件事。 我必须成为27岁。

所以我撒了谎。

在与更成熟的女性进行了几次尴尬的约会之后——“你以什么为生？”，嗯…… 我是天才少年？ – 我和 M 搞了一次约会。

M 和我在我以前的数字广告网络工作所在的街道上相遇。 我握了握她的手，连忙说道：“我们离开这里吧，我所有的老同事都在这儿闲逛，我不想碰到他们。” 我们去吃“穷小子”三明治并自己付餐费。 然后我们去散步，最后到安大略湖。 很好。 M很漂亮而且很安静。 我一直认为房间里最安静的人往往是最聪明的。 那时我经历过很多次糟糕的约会，知道“美好的约会”实际上是一个远远高于平均水平的约会。

这就是我再次约她出去的原因。 第二次约会（用啤酒润滑）谈话进行得很顺利。 我们都喜欢《星际迷航：TNG》，并且对电子音乐有着相似的品味。 她是一名时装设计专业的学生，​​我想象她会做出一些花哨前卫的废话。 就像吞没人身体的大气球服装。

第三次约会是在 Stones’ Place，在这家有点热闹的酒吧里，随着美妙的音乐跳舞，在沙发上聊天。 那天，M 将我姐妹们的年龄、我们之间的差距以及我 27 岁的事实放在一起，并闻到了骗子的骗子裤子着火的味道。

我不知道当我告诉M我正忙着“成为一名企业家”，请了两年假时，她脑子里在想什么。

那是九月。 我们访问了 50 个网站。 “那是一半了，Baybee”！

我和 M 和她的朋友在一家“亚洲融合”餐厅 1 外出，我收到了 A 发来的短信。 她重新考虑了并想再次见到我。 我在这里考虑了替代时间线。 是选择一个安静、缓慢燃烧的人，还是和一个我迷恋的人一起看完一个未完成的故事。 也许这根本不是一种权衡。 M 和我并不排斥。 我喜欢追求多种选择。

我没有回短信。

菲利克斯和我正在将我们生成的网站提交到在线目录。 向平台添加功能，以便它们在 Google 中排名更高。 我们实施了一个自定义分析系统（我们不会使用谷歌分析——不能让大熊知道这些网站都是相关的）。 资金源源不断地流入——hobbypartz.com 支付了 73 美分的佣金，fabric.com 支付了 4.95 美元，undergroundhiphop.com 支付了 2.2 美元。

12 月，我们达到了 100 个网站的里程碑。 十六年后，我不记得我们是如何庆祝的，但我们一定是这样做的。 那一年，我们的支出为 1,800 美元，收入为 1,300 美元。

令人欣慰的是，我们是白手起家的。 我们正在建设一项资产。 这将成为未来的被动收入来源。

2011 年，菲利克斯和我继续“营业”，但没有发展我们的网站网络。 我记得调整过一些东西并尝试过不同的设计。 所有这些都是为了尝试鼓励更多人点击“立即购买”按钮。 我可以看到我们有几个新的竞争对手在玩同样的游戏。 他们的排名技术比我们的风险更大，也更有效：通过使用“临时域名”服务创建大量网站，而不是为每个域名付费。

我很保守，坚持认为我们不要堕落到这个水平。 我还坚持避免在我们的网站上投放付费广告，认为我们应该让访问者 100% 专注于点击“购买”按钮。 我为了额外的现金而从事自由职业。 这笔额外收入使我能够将储蓄的使用时间远远超出我的预期。

我有很多多余的时间，所以决定把咖啡当作一件事情来做。 我经常去菲利克斯附近新开的时尚第三波咖啡馆。 带书去读时，我会坚持总是点一杯美式咖啡。 我的逻辑是，这是一种如此简单的饮料，如果咖啡师没有达到高调，那么“无处可藏”。

最喜欢的是由 3 个朋友经营的男装和咖啡馆组合，每个人都在那里兼职。 它有很棒的美式咖啡，售价 2 美元。 我称之为“咖啡/衣服”，但 M 会指出这不是它的真实名称。 这只是贴在他们窗户上的短语之一，比咖啡馆的真实名称更吸引人：失物招领。

我和M的关系发展得很慢。 我们听了 Miniature Tigers 和 Com Truise。 她把我介绍给了格鲁姆。 尽管企业家和学生的日程安排总是空闲的，但我们还是每周见一次面。 我需要远离人群的大量空间。

四月份，M邀请我观看作为她项目毕业典礼的时装秀。 那是我第一次看到她的设计。 带着她的系列的模特最后走上T台——这是一场结束时装秀的荣耀之地。 她的衣服充满几何感，充满未来感，但又很讨人喜欢。 我真的很喜欢他们！2

那一年，我通过网站和自由职业赚了 5,300 美元。

菲利克斯和我焦躁不安地想要赚更多的钱。 这意味着添加更多网站。 因此，2012 年初，我开始招募一名实习生来增加我们的产能。 我最终参加了附近一所大学主办的“学生创业”活动。 这是一种快速约会活动，创业项目的学生与创始人交谈，双方可以互相选择实习机会。

此次活动共有8名企业家和16名学生参加。 还有一个转折：

每个创业者只能选择一名学生。 每个学生只能选择一名企业家。 如果不匹配就没有实习机会。

这是高风险的，我必须发现有才华的学生，同时用一个故事与他们闲聊，告诉他们为什么他们应该在几乎不带来任何现金的网站上为我们做重复的劳动。

有一个学生，比其他人都遥遥领先。 她显然雄心勃勃，能力出众。 她已经有了自己的生意，制作珠宝并在网上销售。 凭借她对电子商务的理解以及我教她所有数字营销和技术技巧的能力，合作的好处是不可否认的。

只有一个复杂之处：我发现她非常有吸引力。 无论是身体上还是她的创业精神。 请记住，我将在 30 岁时成为百万富翁。 我们的波长相同。 这将是梦之队。 我只是在我狡猾的小骨头里知道这一点。

亲爱的读者，今天的我可能很聪明，是良好行为的典范，但在 25 岁时，我知道我不能只保持专业。 所以我必须考虑我所处的缓慢燃烧的关系，以及替代道路的令人兴奋的可能性——听着，我什至没有做任何事情，这纯粹是可选性，你听说过可选性吗？

我决定远离麻烦。

我的选择是房间里第二强的学生，D。 他是一个傲慢的人，说话很健谈，并且专注于创业精神，这是商学院很少有的人。3 D 也选择了我！

之后，政府给我发了一封电子邮件：D 不应该在那个房间里。 他根本没有参加合作创业课程。 他们甚至不知道他是否想参加课程。 哇——D 很有勇气。

D 最终为我们实习。 我向他展示了如何将数千种产品的数据源组织成类别。 然后他就去上班了。 我会通过电子邮件向他发送新的工作任务。 我们每两周会面一次，回顾他的进展。

令人惊讶的是，D 的工作表现很糟糕。

他在网站上填充产品的速度很慢。 更重要的是，在我们的会议期间，他不断地向我提出有关我的商业决策的探究性问题。 为什么我要以这种特殊的方式构建东西？ 为什么不在网站上投放广告？ 为什么创建每个网站都需要这么长时间？ 您是否将转售这些域名作为补充收入来源？

我的每一个决定都有充分的理由。 这位学生甚至无法按时完成分配的工作，却扮演着大企业顾问的角色。 谢什。

D是我第一次遇到一种罕见的人。 我一生中只遇到过两个像他一样的人。 这些人是：

  • 日常执行很糟糕，需要其他人的大量支持。
  • 他们是远见卓识的人，探索推动他人走出舒适区的前沿想法。
  • 大八卦——不断地告诉你组织中其他人正在做什么。
  • 试图以他们尚未达到的水平影响事物的政治家。

这些人的品质只符合您在公司中看到的一种角色。 担任该角色的人员不需要亲自动手工作，必须依靠专家来完成。 他们的工作是过度传达某种信息。 他们受雇来提前思考并推动其他人朝不舒服的方向做出改变。 该角色：首席执行官。

像D这样的人是天生的CEO。

悲剧在于，尽管他们天生具备登上顶峰的能力，但他们仍然需要爬上许多苦差事才能获得一席之地。 他们中的大多数人都会成为旅途中的牺牲品。 除非他们被发现并得到支持。

D的合作期结束了。 我对他的建议不屑一顾，但菲利克斯对此持开放态度。 菲利克斯已经感觉到我的做法太保守了。 最终，我最终实施了 D 的所有建议。 他在我身下点燃了一把火。 D 告诉我们，我们业务的关键是数量——尽快建立新网站。 那么，为什么我们如此关注质量，而这却阻碍了我们呢？！

我重新编码了该平台，以便它可以自动将产品分类到“足够好”的类别中，并且我不再花费太多时间为每个网站挑选完美的域名。 我们创建了接下来的 100 个网站，所用时间只是创建前 100 个网站所需时间的一小部分。 我们在网站上投放广告。 他们不但没有分散游客的注意力，反而使收入翻了一番。

生意很成功。 但我正在失去兴趣。 我在一个半小时路程外找到了一份合同工作。 我邀请 M 搬来和我一起住。 我们正在听《Twin Shadow》和《Childish Gambino》。 我们甚至还观看了一位神秘的多伦多音乐家在他享誉全球之前的首次巡演。 我不得不把衣服从卧室移到走廊的壁橱里，以腾出空间。 上班前我会在走廊里疯狂地换衣服。 与 M 分享我的家很困难。 事实是，我嫉妒菲利克斯。 他仍然有他的自由，我可以看到笼子向我袭来。

生活是因为M而变得如此困难吗？或者与其他人一起生活也会同样具有挑战性吗？我做了很多自我反省。 在我尝到了独自生活的滋味后，我决定与任何人一起生活都会遇到同样的问题。 毕竟，我们谈论的是一个需要如此多空间的人，他每周只能见到他的新女友一天。

和M一起生活，我意识到有些事情永远不会改变。 他们是我生活中 M 的永久组成部分。 这位迷人、富有创造力、疯狂有趣的女人以糖蜜般的节奏不断向我展示自己。 我认为我永远不会完全了解她。 我不想：我仍然不知道她的出生名字。 只有她自己选的那一个。

我找到了一份永久工作。 然后是另一个。 我和M结婚了。 做我想做的事情的时间越来越少，而花在协调、小心翼翼、妥协上的时间却越来越多。 但是，即使白天有工作，我仍然可以在晚上挤出时间来学习新的编程语言。 在 M 怀上我们第一个孩子的预产期前两个月，我决定我已经受够了咨询工作，并成为了自由职业者。 我确信她喜欢那个。

当我们的儿子出生时，我忙着招揽顾客，寻找另一份工作，每天凌晨 4:30 起床给他喂饭。 我讨厌父亲的要求。 我感觉自己已经死了，只剩下一个幽灵在地球上行走。 与布里斯托尔委员会的一百个圆圈相呼应，我告诉自己：“我正在和我的儿子一起看日出。 这很好。 一起度过了愉快的经历”。 当周围没有人的时候，我在厨房的地板上哭了。

随着时间的流逝，我找到了一个担任管理职责的好职位。 不再需要学习编程语言，也不再有兴趣项目。 我对自己的时间被对他人的责任所吞噬而感到不满4。 我经常说如果有时间的话，希望写下工作中的具体成就。 最后，M 告诉我，我对这篇文章思考了很多，所以我需要去完成它。 她会为我腾出不间断的时间来做这件事。 因为她，我写下了这该死的东西。 这是我的第一篇长文。 我只有在回顾时才能看到旅程的第一步。

3年内我们搬了3次家。

当我们终于感觉自己掌控了生活时，我们欢迎女儿来到这个世界。 我现在不再是一个空虚的幽灵，而是一个愤怒的恶魔。

这些年来我经常想起菲利克斯。

我会永远记得他在那个房间里。 我在那扇巨大的窗户前侧身看着他。 房间里摆满了他妈妈搬出去时给他买的家具：黑色的沙发、黑色的电脑椅、黑色的电视柜、黑色的电视。 “当你自己的孩子搬出去时，为他们这样做”，她说。 她教他如何在他的第一间公寓里做饭。 喜欢又不复杂。

现在是凌晨 1 点。 我在哄女儿入睡时昏倒了，然后又醒了。 这是日常工作，通常需要一个小时。 到现在已经7年了。 自从我和妻子单独睡在床上已经七年了。 首先我们之间有一个婴儿。 然后是一个小女孩。 然后是大姑娘。

现在是凌晨 1 点，我昏昏沉沉地拖着脚步，头发平放在床垫上。 餐桌旁，M 正拿着她的陶器。 如果说有谁与睡眠的关系比我更遗憾的话，那就是她了。 她手里拿着一个素烧小花瓶，上面涂着白釉。 然后是粉色。 我告诉她我受到了写作的启发。 但如果我现在打开电脑，明天我就完蛋了。

“努力吧”，她说。 “明天没有工作，可以睡个午觉”。

菲利克斯还二十四岁。

我快四十了。

不再是鬼了。 M 通过纯粹的重复力量让我爱上了 IVE 和 Cukak 的混音。

我不是恶魔。 最近，我为 M 演奏了 Altın Gün。 但我想她会讨厌它，因为唱歌会惹恼她。 我是对的！ 哈！

我只是一个经常被激怒的普通人。 经历中年重塑。 拥有像瑞士奶酪一样的大脑，得益于多年的睡眠不足。 我儿子最近告诉我他最喜欢的歌曲是 The Look。

我晚上会抽出时间来写作和编码。 养育孩子的要求不那么高，但我还没有变得喜欢它。 就像：如果你每天给我一大汤匙粪便，然后每天只喂一小茶匙，我不会突然开始喜欢粪便的味道。

菲利克斯和我分道扬镳。 他专注于自己的项目，从未因对他人的责任而放慢脚步。 仍在听流行音乐。 在市中心的街区喝咖啡，这与我居住的昏昏欲睡、中年、中等成就的市中心街区有很大不同。 我的邻居从来没有发生过任何事情。 周一我什至买不到羊角面包，因为当地店主决定现在休息一天。

你的生活中有菲利克斯吗？

我想我们都这样做。 我们都有一个自己的影子版本，当我们人到中年、体重减轻时，那个版本只是保持年轻、充满活力，继续生活。

我经常想起菲利克斯的自由。

但我的记忆跟我开了个玩笑。 我从来没有告诉过你在那间公寓里我是如此孤独以至于我哭了5。 我从来没有对任何人发脾气，因为他们分散了我的注意力，让我感到饥饿和愤怒。 但那是因为除了我之外没有人。 从来没有成为一名企业家。 当我想起那个时候，那是一个永远的夏天。 我不记得冬天了。 我敢打赌他们很糟糕，和下一个需要建设的无聊网站一起关在室内。 袖扣！ 马缰绳！ 振动公鸡环！

我认为我们能为我们的菲利克斯做的最诚实的事情就是进一步深入幻想。 充实他们生活的细节。 让它们具体化。

当我想到菲利克斯的伴侣或孩子时，我情不自禁地想象出与我相似的生活。 因为他也想要孩子。 他想要一个合作伙伴。 他不会留在那个街区。 而且不管怎样，那个地方已经和十六年前不一样了。

菲利克斯可能做出了与我类似的选择。 做出了妥协。 我能想象的妥协、妥协、谈判的唯一选择就是永远不要让自己去爱。

现在是凌晨 5 点 30 分。 太阳开始升起。

M 三个小时前就睡了，只剩下我一个人。

有时我坐在那里，想我很幸运。 所以非常非常幸运。

我在我狡猾的小骨头里感觉到了这一点。
